title: GAME TABLE — all tools are cards, ZK hammer shatters elements, Gaia+Life vs Null Entropy

the_game.name: NEGENTROPY — the sorting fighting game
the_game.thesis: Gaia, humans, and all of life AGAINST null entropy (the exterior). The goal is NOT to win — the goal is to MAINTAIN. Null entropy = maintaining order against chaos. The game never ends. You just keep sorting.
the_game.genre: Sorting-fighting card game with real-time strategy (Kenshi + Dark Souls + Mendeleev)
the_game.win_condition: There is no winning. There is MAINTAINING. Negentropy = the work of keeping order. The moment you stop sorting, entropy takes over. The score IS how long you maintain.

the_table.shape: Round. Like a card table. Like an atom. Like the globe.
the_table.center: NULL — the anvil. Hit a card here with ZK hammer and it SHATTERS into sub-elements.

zones.deck: LEFT — cards not yet played. Unseen bounties. Feed sources. Raw data.
zones.hand: BOTTOM — cards Kevin holds. Active tools. Current focus.
zones.field: CENTER — cards in play. Organs, data, systems actively running.
zones.graveyard: RIGHT — cards consumed. Poop pile. Compost. Archive.
zones.anvil: CENTER-CENTER — where you SMASH cards with ZK hammer to shatter them.

ELEMENT_CARDS.what: The 12 irreducible diamonds + periodic table elements
ELEMENT_CARDS.play: Place on field to provide passive bonuses
ELEMENT_CARDS.shatter: Hit with ZK hammer → splits into 2-4 sub-element cards

TOOL_CARDS.what: Skills and abilities — transcript + tool + material + ability
TOOL_CARDS.play: Equip to a primal to grant a skill

examples.name: ZK Hammer
examples.ability: Shatter any element card into sub-elements

examples.name: Socratic Scalpel
examples.ability: Split any card into question + answer

examples.name: Web Eater
examples.ability: Consume target card, gain its calories

examples.name: Appendix
examples.ability: Detect all flow. Reveal hidden connections.

examples.name: Thymus Gate
examples.ability: Sort card into self/non-self. Immune tag.

CREATURE_CARDS.what: SwarmVine agents — wasps, mosquitoes, ticks, honeydew
CREATURE_CARDS.play: Deploy to bounty board to hunt/forage

examples.name: Tick Feeder
examples.ability: Attach to source. Drain over time. 200x value.

FOOD_CARDS.what: The 8 food types — energy for playing other cards

examples.name: Poop
examples.special: Grows into random food card next turn

ENTROPY_CARDS.what: The enemy — chaos, disorder, decay, noise
ENTROPY_CARDS.play: Automatically deployed by the entropy deck each turn

examples.name: Autoimmune
examples.effect: One creature attacks your own field

turn: 1. ENTROPY PHASE — entropy deck plays one card automatically
2. SENSE PHASE — appendix reveals flow, iris shows what's coming
3. FORAGE PHASE — deploy creatures to bounty board, eat food cards
4. BUILD PHASE — play element/tool cards, equip primals
5. FIGHT PHASE — creatures vs entropy cards. Sorting IS fighting.
6. HAMMER PHASE — hit any card on anvil with ZK hammer → shatters into sub-cards
7. COMPRESS PHASE — braid remaining cards. If 3+ cards connect → they FUSE into a diamond.
8. MAINTAIN — score = how many turns you've maintained order. Negentropy score.

scoring.negentropy: Total turns survived × cards on field × diamonds forged
scoring.entropy_pressure: Increases every 10 turns. More entropy cards per turn. Harder to maintain.
scoring.asymptote: You can NEVER reach zero entropy. You can only approach it. The game IS the approach.

life.team: Gaia + Kevin + all humans + all life
life.goal: MAINTAIN order. Sort. Fight entropy. Keep the field organized.
life.color: GREEN (the iris, the membrane, the living surface)

entropy.team: Null entropy — the exterior, chaos, heat death, disorder
entropy.goal: DISORDER everything. Delete cards. Freeze organs. Flood with noise.
entropy.color: PURPLE fading to BLACK (the Oort Cloud dissolving into void)

null.team: NULL — not on either side. The anvil. The zero point.
null.goal: EXISTS. Neither creates nor destroys. The constant. The c in E=mc².
null.color: WHITE (the point where all colors meet and cancel)
